Public Notice of Mayor's Order

Order No. 2026-24

Pursuant to Mayor's Order No. 2026-24, issued by Mayor Bobby Peden and attested by City Clerk Keila Tuttle, under authority granted by Texas Space Commission Order No. 2025-02, Ordinance No. 2026-2, and the City's Emergency Management Plan, the City of Starbase is temporarily closing Boca Chica Beach, Texas State Highway 4 (from FM 1419/Oklahoma Ave. to the beach entrance), and associated FAA hazard areas/Clear Zone to protect public health and safety during SpaceX spaceflight activities.

Primary Closure Period
10/25/26 from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Alternate Dates
10/26/26 from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM
